evidence.reason: The validator compares orig.notna() with the coercion mask, so non-null malformed text is rejected while true nulls are not treated as conversion failures. The same separation exists in fit at lines 194-219 and apply at lines 267-287.
Production apply behavior is tested for out-of-range, infinity, and malformed text, and true NaN warm-up is tested at lines 197-209. A realistic 'bad' or 'NaN' string is now rejected.
supplied_ff bypasses dispersion filtering and enforces the ordered allowlist and exact count at lines 81-103.
Bounded on-chain values are validated, including infinity and no-finite-value checks, before a FEATURE_SCALE_MANIFEST override is returned at line 221.
Fresh split frames are validated before scaling and Phase 2; the cached path performs the same validation at lines 3154-3158.
The production catalog test retains a constant and 98%-NaN required feature and asserts all 30 ordered features.

_strategy stamps the current digest, but out.update(extra) runs afterward and repairs only missing digests at lines 566-569. An extra strategy_contract containing a stale non-empty digest therefore produces an internally inconsistent RB artifact.

Phase 5 selects the first truthy digest instead of requiring every present digest copy to equal the current digest. A current top-level digest with stale provenance or MTF-manifest digest is accepted.

A stale or missing MTF archive raises built-in ValueError from load_mtf_archive_payload, but load_strategies catches only OSError, JSONDecodeError, and the unrelated custom ValidationError at line 952. A valid strategy with a stale archive can abort loading instead of being rejected/skipped.
The writer preserves feature_contract_digest but does not validate or reconcile nested digest copies, so it preserves the inconsistent artifact described above.

A stale LWC archive does trigger run_phase2 rebuild, but the rebuilt archive is persisted only when all_lwc_rules is non-empty at run_phase2 lines 4401-4403 and run_mtf_composition lines 4596-4601. If discovery returns no rules, the stale file remains on disk.
The LWC recovery test supplies a non-empty mocked rebuild and therefore does not exercise the stale-file/empty-rebuild case.
JSON lists and non-dict payloads are rejected before schema validation, and dict payloads require a current digest at lines 395-408.
Both load_mtf_rule_archive and load_mtf_archive_payload are tested against a legacy list payload and must raise.
Split cache mismatch and missing-digest rejection are covered.
MTF missing-digest, list rejection, and non-empty LWC/HWC/MWC rebuild cases are covered through lines 565.
Phase 2 tests only load a missing-digest archive and assert None; they do not verify replacement/rebuild behavior when save_archive receives an invalid archive.
RB mismatch, missing-digest, and normal/generated_lwc output cases are covered, but there is no Phase 5 test for a stale MTF archive escaping as ValueError or for inconsistent digest copies.
Writer coverage checks preservation of a fabricated digest only; it does not test current-digest stamping or consistency with nested provenance.

checks.evidence: Numeric coercion, manifest validation, catalog retention, list rejection, and non-empty rebuilds are correct. The RB digest can be overridden or inconsistently accepted, and Phase 5 lets built-in archive ValueError escape instead of fail-closed skipping (gpu_fuzzy_trader/rb_governor.py:541-569; gpu_fuzzy_trader/phases/phase5_oos.py:816-827,880-952).

The added tests exercise the happy/non-empty recovery paths and simple missing-digest loaders, but do not exercise Phase 5 stale-MTF error handling, empty LWC rebuilds, nested digest inconsistency, or Phase 2 invalid-archive replacement (tests/unit/test_mtf_pipeline_integration.py:293-565; tests/unit/test_phase2_rule_pool.py:1189-1203; tests/unit/test_phase5_oos.py:475-594).

The post-impact traversal reports 411 impacted nodes and reaches the RB, writer, MTF, and Phase 5 contracts. The new archive and digest behavior therefore affects deployment loading, not only isolated helpers.

Digest handling is not uniform across top-level, provenance, nested strategy, and MTF manifest copies; Phase 5 uses first-truthy selection, while the RB boundary repairs only missing values. Bounded-value validation is also duplicated across validator, fit, and apply paths (gpu_fuzzy_trader/features/fuzzy_scaling.py:144-168,194-219,267-287).

BASE..HEAD contains the 25 package files listed by the review package. The second-fix commit changes 11 in-scope files; untracked .antigravity/ and .opencode/ scratch are not treated as production scope violations.

The deterministic package reports passing related suites and the implementer claims 451 passed, but independent .venv pytest and Python commands were denied by the shell permission policy. git diff --check for BASE..HEAD was clean.

findings.title: Phase 5 lets stale MTF archive errors escape strategy loading
findings.description: load_mtf_archive_payload raises built-in ValueError for a missing or mismatched digest, but load_strategies catches only OSError, JSONDecodeError, and the custom ValidationError. A valid RB/MTF strategy with a stale archive can abort load_strategies instead of being rejected and skipped as its documented invalid-file behavior requires.

findings.title: RB digest stamping can preserve stale nested metadata
findings.description: _strategy updates the stamped output with extra after computing the current digest and only restores missing values. An extra strategy_contract or provenance with a stale non-empty digest remains inconsistent, while Phase 5 selects the first truthy digest at phase5_oos.py:816-827 and can accept the artifact.

findings.title: Empty LWC rebuild leaves the stale archive on disk
findings.description: After a stale LWC archive triggers discovery, the archive is saved only when all_lwc is truthy. An empty discovery result leaves the old digest-mismatched file in place, violating the stale-cache stop condition and causing repeated stale-cache handling on later runs.

findings.title: Required invalidation and recovery edge paths remain untested
findings.description: Coverage proves non-empty MTF rebuilds and basic missing-digest rejection, but does not test Phase 5 stale-archive error handling, empty LWC replacement, Phase 2 invalid-archive replacement, or consistency of all RB digest copies. The writer test also accepts an arbitrary fabricated digest rather than verifying the current boundary digest.
